A school garden combining practical learning with adult-managed food production.

At the next visit, ask which tasks were manageable and which beds need support. Household financial or survey details require appropriate access.
A market-oriented garden with more intensive growing blocks and a store.

Confirm the crop plan, produce destinations, water reliability and complete input costs before assessing margins.

Planning considerations: establishment care and long-term responsibility are the main planning questions. A tree drawn on the plan is not evidence that it is planted or bearing fruit.
Agree a care roster and a planting inventory, then monitor survival by planting cohort. Confirm water arrangements before adding planting commitments.
Record the condition of planted trees and distinguish existing, new and replacement trees in later reports.

Planning considerations: shared responsibilities, water access and fair record keeping are the main operational issues. Group membership must not be inferred from photographs.

Assess complete packages where needed: water storage with its base and connections; planting with establishment care; solar equipment with commissioning. Verify quantities and dependencies before pricing.

Keep approved current-project work separate from additional needs outside the budget. The proposed Funding & delivery workflow will connect those needs to costed BOQs and funder allocations; that full workflow is not yet available.

g18.title: Delivery evidence and next actions
lines: Priority follow-up: confirm establishment tasks, responsible people and the first dated progress check.
Review the garden with the responsible adult and record any access or maintenance issues before the next reporting period.

Record installed tanks and storage capacity separately from measured water collected. Record commissioned solar capacity separately from energy produced. Record planted trees separately from survival and fruit harvest.
Use dated photos, receipts, visit records and appropriate operational checks. A paid invoice or an AI-generated image does not verify a completed installation.

rows.english: The saved report includes this garden's site photograph, layout, assessment narrative, programme figures and next actions. Generate a new report below to create another copy.
rows.zu: Umbiko ogciniwe uhlanganisa isithombe sendawo yale ngadi, ukuhleleka kwayo, umbhalo wokuhlola, izibalo zohlelo nezinyathelo ezilandelayo. Dala omunye umbiko ngezansi ukuze wenze enye ikhophi.
rows.st: Tlaleho e bolokilweng e kenyelletsa setshwantsho sa sebaka sa tshimo ena, moralo, tlhaloso ya tekolo, dipalo tsa lenaneo le mehato e latelang. Etsa tlaleho e ntjha ka tlase ho etsa kopi e nngwe.
rows.ts: Xiviko lexi hlayisiweke xi katsa xifaniso xa ndhawu ya ntanga lowu, pulani, nhlamuselo ya nkambelo, tinhlayo ta nongonoko ni magoza lama landzelaka. Endla xiviko lexintshwa laha hansi ku endla kopi yin’wana.
rows.ve: Muvhigo wo vhulungwaho u katela tshifanyiso tsha fhethu ha ngade iyi, mveledziso, ṱhaluso ya tsenguluso, mbalo dza mbekanyamushumo na maga a tevhelaho. Itani muvhigo muswa afho fhasi u ita iṅwe khophi.

rows.english: A food garden supporting an early learning setting, with adult-managed growing and a separate play space.
rows.zu: Ingadi yokudla esekela indawo yokufunda yezingane ezincane, lapho ukutshala kuphathwa abantu abadala futhi kunendawo yokudlala ehlukile.
rows.st: Tshimo ya dijo e tshehetsang sebaka sa thuto ya bana ba banyenyane, ka temo e laolwang ke batho ba baholo le sebaka se arohaneng sa ho bapala.
rows.ts: Ntanga wa swakudya lowu seketelaka ndhawu ya dyondzo ya vana lavatsongo, laha ku byala ku lawuriwaka hi lavakulu naswona ku nga ni ndhawu yo tlanga leyi hambaneke.
rows.ve: Ngade ya zwiḽiwa i tikedzaho fhethu ha u guda ha vhana vhaṱuku, hune u ṱavha ha langiwa nga vhahulwane nahone ha vha na fhethu ha u tamba ho fhambanaho.

rows.english: The schematic separates the crèche building and play space from vegetables and staple crops. The water point is shown away from the main growing blocks.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kwehlukanisa isakhiwo senkulisa nendawo yokudlala nemifino nezitshalo eziyinhloko. Iphuzu lamanzi liboniswe kude nezindawo ezinkulu zokutshala.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o arola moaho wa kretjhe le sebaka sa ho bapala ho meroho le dijalo tsa motheo. Ntlha ya metsi e bontshitswe hole le dikarolo tse kgolo tsa temo.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi hambanisa muako wa khirexe ni ndhawu yo tlanga eka matsavu ni swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka. Ndhawu ya mati yi kombiwe yi ri ekule ni swiphemu leswikulu swo byala.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u fhambanya tshifhaṱo tsha khiretshi na fhethu ha u tamba kha miroho na zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme. Fhethu ha maḓi ho sumbedzwa kule na zwipiḓa zwihulwane zwa u ṱavha.

rows.english: Planning considerations: keeping the play area clear and controlling adult access to tools and water are the main design considerations. Food production must fit the daily work of the carers.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: ukugcina indawo yokudlala ingenazithiyo nokulawula ukufinyelela kwabantu abadala emathuluzini nasemanzini yizinto ezisemqoka ekuklameni. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kufanele kuhambisane nomsebenzi wansuku zonke wabanakekeli.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: ho boloka sebaka sa ho bapala se bulehile le ho laola phihlello ya batho ba baholo ho disebediswa le metsi ke dintlha tse kgolo tsa moralo. Tlhahiso ya dijo e lokela ho dumellana le mosebetsi wa letsatsi le letsatsi wa bahlokomedi.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: ku hlayisa ndhawu yo tlanga yi nga ri na swihinga ni ku lawula mfikelelo wa lavakulu eka switirhisiwa ni mati i swa nkoka eka pulani. Ku humesa swakudya ku fanele ku fambisana ni mintirho ya siku na siku ya vahlayisi.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: u ita uri fhethu ha u tamba hu dzule hu si na zwikhukhulisi na u langa u swikelela ha vhahulwane kha zwishumiswa na maḓi ndi zwa ndeme kha pulane. U bveledza zwiḽiwa zwi tea u tshimbidzana na mushumo wa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe wa vhaṱhogomeli.

rows.english: Review the separation of growing, play and storage spaces. Confirm who maintains the garden during closures and who records produce used in meals.
rows.zu: Buyekezani ukwehlukaniswa kwezindawo zokutshala, zokudlala nezokugcina impahla. Qinisekisani ukuthi ubani onakekela ingadi ngesikhathi sokuvalwa nokuthi ubani oqopha ukudla okusetshenziswa ekudleni.
rows.st: Hlahlobang karohano ya dibaka tsa ho lema, ho bapala le polokelo. Netefatsang hore na ke mang ya hlokomelang tshimo nakong ya ho kwalwa le ya rekotang dihlahiswa tse sebediswang dijong.
rows.ts: Kambelani ku hambanisiwa ka tindhawu to byala, to tlanga ni to hlayisa swilo. Tiyisisani loyi a hlayisaka ntanga loko ku pfariwile ni loyi a rhekhodaka leswi tirhisiwaka eka swakudya.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani u fhambanywa ha fhethu ha u ṱavha, u tamba na u vhulunga. Khwaṱhisedzani uri ndi nnyi ane a ṱhogomela ngade musi hu tshi valiwa na ane a rekhoda zwiḽiwa zwi shumiswaho kha zwiḽiwa zwo bikwaho.

rows.english: Review the garden with the responsible adult and record any access or maintenance issues before the next reporting period.
rows.zu: Buyekezani ingadi nomuntu omdala ophethe futhi niqophe noma yiziphi izinkinga zokufinyelela noma zokunakekela ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokubika esilandelayo.
rows.st: Hlahlobang tshimo le motho e moholo ya ikarabellang mme le rekote mathata afe kapa afe a phihlello kapa tlhokomelo pele ho nako e latelang ya tlaleho.
rows.ts: Kambelani ntanga ni munhu lonkulu loyi a nga ni vutihlamuleri kutani mi rhekhoda swiphiqo swa mfikelelo kumbe nhlayiso ku nga si fika nkarhi lowu landzelaka wo vika.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani ngade na muhulwane a re na vhuḓifhinduleli ni rekhode thaidzo dza u swikelela kana u ṱhogomela phanḓa ha tshifhinga tshi tevhelaho tsha u vhiga.

rows.english: A school garden combining practical learning with adult-managed food production.
rows.zu: Ingadi yesikole ehlanganisa ukufunda ngokwenza nokukhiqizwa kokudla okuphethwe abantu abadala.
rows.st: Tshimo ya sekolo e kopanyang ho ithuta ka ho etsa le tlhahiso ya dijo e laolwang ke batho ba baholo.
rows.ts: Ntanga wa xikolo lowu hlanganisaka dyondzo yo endla hi mavoko ni ku humesa swakudya loku lawuriwaka hi lavakulu.
rows.ve: Ngade ya tshikolo i ṱanganyaho u guda nga u ita na u bveledza zwiḽiwa hu langiwaho nga vhahulwane.

rows.english: The drawing includes a school building, a learning area, vegetable blocks, staple crops and trees. Growing space is separate from the learning gathering area.
rows.zu: Umdwebo uhlanganisa isakhiwo sesikole, indawo yokufunda, izindawo zemifino, izitshalo eziyinhloko nezihlahla. Indawo yokutshala ihlukile endaweni yokuhlangana yokufunda.
rows.st: Setshwantsho se kenyelletsa moaho wa sekolo, sebaka sa ho ithuta, dikarolo tsa meroho, dijalo tsa motheo le difate. Sebaka sa temo se arohane le sebaka sa ho kopana bakeng sa ho ithuta.
rows.ts: Xifaniso xi katsa muako wa xikolo, ndhawu yo dyondza, swiphemu swa matsavu, swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka ni mirhi. Ndhawu yo byala yi hambanile ni ndhawu yo hlengeletana ku dyondza.
rows.ve: Nyolo i katela tshifhaṱo tsha tshikolo, fhethu ha u guda, zwipiḓa zwa miroho, zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme na miri. Fhethu ha u ṱavha ho fhambana na fhethu ha u kuvhangana u guda.

rows.english: Planning considerations: lesson access, tool storage and care during school holidays are the operational priorities. Adult programme participants are separate from pupil headcounts.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: ukufinyelela ezifundweni, ukugcina amathuluzi nokunakekela ngesikhathi samaholide esikole yizinto ezisemqoka ekusebenzeni. Abantu abadala ababambe iqhaza ohlelweni bahlukaniswa nezibalo zabafundi.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: phihlello ya dithuto, polokelo ya disebediswa le tlhokomelo nakong ya matsatsi a phomolo a sekolo ke tse tlang pele tshebetsong. Bankakarolo ba baholo ba lenaneo ba arohane le dipalo tsa bana ba sekolo.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: mfikelelo wa tidyondzo, ku hlayisa switirhisiwa ni nhlayiso hi nkarhi wa tiholideyi ta xikolo i swa nkoka eku tirheni. Vatekaxiave lavakulu va nongonoko va hambanisiwa ni nhlayo ya vadyondzi.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: u swikelela ngudo, u vhulunga zwishumiswa na u ṱhogomela nga holodei dza tshikolo ndi zwine zwa tea u rangiswa kha mushumo. Vhashelamulenzhe vhahulwane vha mbekanyamushumo vha fhambanywa na mbalo dza vhagudiswa.

rows.english: Agree a holiday care roster, link practical sessions to attendance records and record how produce is used.
rows.zu: Vumelanani ngohlelo lokunakekela ngesikhathi samaholide, xhumanisani izikhathi zokufunda ngokwenza namarekhodi okuba khona futhi niqophe ukuthi umkhiqizo usetshenziswa kanjani.
rows.st: Dumellanang ka lenane la tlhokomelo nakong ya phomolo, hokahanyang dithuto tsa ho etsa le direkoto tsa ho ba teng mme le rekote tshebediso ya dihlahiswa.
rows.ts: Pfumelelanani hi nongonoko wa nhlayiso hi tiholideyi, hlanganisani swiphemu swa dyondzo yo endla ni tirhekhodo ta lava nga kona kutani mi rhekhoda ndlela leyi ntshovelo wu tirhisiwaka ha yona.
rows.ve: Tendelani mutevhe wa u ṱhogomela nga holodei, ṱumanyani zwifhinga zwa u guda nga u ita na rekhodo dza u vha hone ni rekhode uri zwibveledzwa zwi shumiswa hani.

rows.english: Review learning participation and garden care with the school contact. Keep child-identifying information out of public reports.
rows.zu: Buyekezani ukubamba iqhaza ekufundeni nokunakekelwa kwengadi nomuntu wesikole oxhumana naye. Ningafaki imininingwane engahlonza izingane emibikweni yomphakathi.
rows.st: Hlahlobang ho nka karolo thutong le tlhokomelo ya tshimo le moemedi wa sekolo. Bolokang tlhahisoleseding e ka tsebahatsang bana e le kantle ho ditlaleho tsa setjhaba.
rows.ts: Kambelani ku teka xiave eka dyondzo ni nhlayiso wa ntanga ni loyi mi tihlanganisaka na yena exikolweni. Mi nga katsi vuxokoxoko byo tivekisa vana eka swiviko swa mani na mani.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani u shela mulenzhe kha u guda na u ṱhogomelwa ha ngade na muambedzani wa tshikolo. Ni songo katela mafhungo a no ṱalula vhana kha mivhigo ya nnyi na nnyi.

rows.english: A household garden with food-growing space alongside the home and yard.
rows.zu: Ingadi yasekhaya enendawo yokutshala ukudla eceleni kwendlu negceke.
rows.st: Tshimo ya lelapa e nang le sebaka sa ho lema dijo pela ntlo le lebala.
rows.ts: Ntanga wa muti lowu nga ni ndhawu yo byala swakudya etlhelo ka yindlu ni rivala.
rows.ve: Ngade ya muḓi i re na fhethu ha u ṱavha zwiḽiwa tsini na nnḓu na muṱa.

rows.english: The schematic retains the home and yard, with vegetables, a staple area, trees and a water point shown separately.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kugcina indlu negceke, kubonise imifino, indawo yezitshalo eziyinhloko, izihlahla nephuzu lamanzi ngokwehlukana.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o boloka ntlo le lebala, mme o bontsha meroho, sebaka sa dijalo tsa motheo, difate le ntlha ya metsi ka ho arohana.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi hlayisa yindlu ni rivala, yi komba matsavu, ndhawu ya swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka, mirhi ni ndhawu ya mati swi hambanisiwile.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u vhulunga nnḓu na muṱa, wa sumbedza miroho, fhethu ha zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme, miri na fhethu ha maḓi zwo fhambanywa.

rows.english: Planning considerations: the garden should fit household routines, available labour and safe access around the home. The site boundary is larger than the planted area.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: ingadi kufanele ihambisane nenqubo yasekhaya, abasebenzi abakhona nokuhamba okuphephile eduze kwendlu. Indawo engaphakathi komngcele inkulu kunendawo etshaliwe.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: tshimo e lokela ho dumellana le mesebetsi ya lelapa, basebetsi ba fumanehang le phihlello e bolokehileng pela lehae. Sebaka se ka hare ho moedi se seholo ho feta sebaka se lenngweng.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: ntanga wu fanele wu fambisana ni mintirho ya muti, vatirhi lava nga kona ni mfikelelo lowu hlayisekeke ekusuhi ni kaya. Ndhawu leyi nga endzeni ka ndzilakano yi kulu ku feta leyi byariweke.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: ngade i tea u tshimbidzana na mishumo ya muḓi, vhashumi vha re hone na u swikelela ho tsireledzeaho tsini na muḓi. Vhupo vhu re ngomu ha mukano ndi vhuhulwane kha ho ṱavhiwaho.

rows.english: Confirm household priorities and water access; record food kept at home separately from donations and sales.
rows.zu: Qinisekisani izinto ezisemqoka ekhaya nokufinyelela emanzini; qophani ukudla okugcinwa ekhaya ngokwehlukana neminikelo nokuthengisiwe.
rows.st: Netefatsang tse tlang pele lelapeng le phihlello ya metsi; rekotang dijo tse bolokwang lapeng ka thoko ho menehelo le thekiso.
rows.ts: Tiyisisani leswi muti wu swi rhangisaka ni mfikelelo wa mati; rhekhodani swakudya leswi hlayisiwaka ekaya hi ku swi hambanisa ni tinyiko ni leswi xavisiweke.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani zwine muḓi wa zwi rangisa na u swikelela maḓi; rekhodani zwiḽiwa zwi vhulungwaho muḓini zwo fhambanywa na zwifhiwa na zwo rengiswaho.

rows.english: At the next visit, ask which tasks were manageable and which beds need support. Household financial or survey details require appropriate access.
rows.zu: Ekuvakasheni okulandelayo, buzani ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi ebilawuleka nokuthi yimiphi imibhede edinga usizo. Imininingwane yezimali noma yocwaningo yasekhaya idinga ukufinyelela okufanele.
rows.st: Ketelong e latelang, botsang hore na ke mesebetsi efe e neng e kgoneha le hore na ke dibethe dife tse hlokang tshehetso. Dintlha tsa ditjhelete tsa lelapa kapa tsa dipatlisiso di hloka phihlello e loketseng.
rows.ts: Eka riendzo leri landzelaka, vutisani leswaku hi yihi mintirho leyi kotekeke ni leswaku hi yihi mibedo leyi lavaka nseketelo. Vuxokoxoko bya timali kumbe bya vulavisisi bya muti byi lava mfikelelo lowu faneleke.
rows.ve: Kha lwendo lu tevhelaho, vhudzisani uri ndi mishumo ifhio yo koneaho na mibete ifhio ine ya ṱoḓa thikhedzo. Mafhungo a masheleni kana a ṱhoḓisiso a muḓi a ṱoḓa u swikelelwa ho teaho.

rows.english: A market-oriented garden with more intensive growing blocks and a store.
rows.zu: Ingadi egxile emakethe enezindawo zokutshala ezisetshenziswa kakhulu nenqolobane.
rows.st: Tshimo e shebaneng le mmaraka, e nang le dikarolo tsa temo e matla le polokelo.
rows.ts: Ntanga lowu kongomisiweke eka makete, wu ri ni swiphemu swo byala ngopfu ni vuhlayiselo.
rows.ve: Ngade yo livhaho kha makete, i re na zwipiḓa zwa u ṱavha nga vhunzhi na vhugalelo.

rows.english: The schematic shows repeated vegetable blocks, a staple area, perimeter trees, a store and a water point. It is an overview, not a construction drawing.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kubonisa izindawo zemifino eziphindaphindiwe, indawo yezitshalo eziyinhloko, izihlahla eziseceleni komngcele, inqolobane nephuzu lamanzi. Kuwukubuka konke, akuwona umdwebo wokwakha.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o bontsha dikarolo tse iphetang tsa meroho, sebaka sa dijalo tsa motheo, difate tse mathokong, polokelo le ntlha ya metsi. Ke kakaretso, ha se setshwantsho sa kaho.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi komba swiphemu leswi phindhiweke swa matsavu, ndhawu ya swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka, mirhi ya le ndzilakaneni, vuhlayiselo ni ndhawu ya mati. I nkatsakanyo, a hi xifaniso xo aka.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u sumbedza zwipiḓa zwa miroho zwi dovhololaho, fhethu ha zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme, miri i re mikukanoni, vhugalelo na fhethu ha maḓi. Ndi manweledzo, a si nyolo ya u fhaṱa.

rows.english: Planning considerations: production records, usable access and harvest handling are central. Recorded harvest weight alone does not establish sales, profit or buyer demand.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: amarekhodi okukhiqiza, ukufinyelela okusebenzisekayo nokuphatha isivuno kusemqoka. Isisindo sesivuno esiqoshiwe sisodwa asiqinisekisi ukuthengisiwe, inzuzo noma isidingo sabathengi.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: direkoto tsa tlhahiso, phihlello e sebedisehang le ho sebetsana le kotulo di bohlokwa. Boima ba kotulo bo rekotilweng feela ha bo netefatse thekiso, phaello kapa tlhoko ya bareki.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: tirhekhodo ta vuhumelerisi, mfikelelo lowu tirhisiwaka ni ku khoma ntshovelo i swa nkoka. Ntiko wa ntshovelo lowu rhekhodiweke wu ri woxe a wu tiyisisi ku xavisa, mpindzulo kumbe xilaveko xa vaxavi.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: rekhodo dza u bveledza, u swikelela hu shumiseaho na u fara khaṋo ndi zwa ndeme. Tshileme tsha khaṋo tsho rekhodiwaho tshi tshoṱhe a tshi khwaṱhisedzi u rengisa, mbuelo kana ṱhoḓea ya vharengi.

rows.english: Confirm the crop plan, produce destinations, water reliability and complete input costs before assessing margins.
rows.zu: Qinisekisani ipulani lezitshalo, izindawo umkhiqizo oya kuzo, ukuthembeka kwamanzi nazo zonke izindleko zokufaka izinto ngaphambi kokuhlola inzuzo.
rows.st: Netefatsang moralo wa dijalo, moo dihlahiswa di yang teng, botshepehi ba phepelo ya metsi le ditjeho tsohle tsa disebediswa pele ho tekolo ya phaello.
rows.ts: Tiyisisani pulani ya swibyariwa, laha ntshovelo wu yaka kona, ku tshembeka ka mati ni tihakelo hinkwato ta leswi nghenisiwaka mi nga si kambela mpindzulo.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani pulane ya zwimela, hune zwibveledzwa zwa ya hone, u fulufhedzea ha maḓi na mbadelo dzoṱhe dza zwine zwa shumiswa phanḓa ha u sengulusa mbuelo.

rows.english: Review dated harvest and sales records together, checking losses and unsold produce rather than treating all harvest as revenue.
rows.zu: Buyekezani ndawonye amarekhodi esivuno nokuthengisiwe anezinsuku, nihlole okulahlekile nokungathengiswanga kunokuthatha sonke isivuno njengemali engenayo.
rows.st: Hlahlobang direkoto tsa kotulo le thekiso tse nang le matsatsi mmoho, le lekole tahlehelo le dihlahiswa tse sa rekiswang ho ena le ho nka kotulo yohle e le lekeno.
rows.ts: Kambelani swin’we tirhekhodo ta ntshovelo ni ku xavisa leti nga ni masiku, mi kambela leswi lahlekeke ni leswi nga xavisiwangiki ematshan’weni yo teka ntshovelo hinkwawo wu ri mali leyi nghenaka.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani rekhodo dza khaṋo na u rengisa dzi re na maḓuvha dzo ṱangana, ni sedze zwo xelelaho na zwi songo rengiswaho nṱhani ha u dzhia khaṋo yoṱhe sa tshelede i dzhenaho.

rows.english: A community planting area with a tree-dominated layout and a smaller vegetable section.
rows.zu: Indawo yokutshala yomphakathi enokuhleleka okugcwele izihlahla nengxenye encane yemifino.
rows.st: Sebaka sa temo sa setjhaba se nang le moralo o nang le difate tse ngata le karolo e nyenyane ya meroho.
rows.ts: Ndhawu yo byala ya muganga leyi nga ni pulani yo tala mirhi ni xiyenge lexitsongo xa matsavu.
rows.ve: Fhethu ha u ṱavha ha tshitshavha hu re na mveledziso wo ḓalaho miri na tshipiḓa tshiṱuku tsha miroho.

rows.english: The schematic contains a tree grid, vegetable beds, a store and a water point. No staple production allocation is included in this tour.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kuhlanganisa imigqa yezihlahla, imibhede yemifino, inqolobane nephuzu lamanzi. Akukho ndawo yokukhiqiza izitshalo eziyinhloko eyabelwe kulolu hambo.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o na le mela ya difate, dibethe tsa meroho, polokelo le ntlha ya metsi. Ha ho sebaka se abetsweng tlhahiso ya dijalo tsa motheo leetong lena.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi katsa giridi ya mirhi, mibedo ya matsavu, vuhlayiselo ni ndhawu ya mati. A ku na ndhawu leyi averiweke ku humesa swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka eka rendzo leri.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u na na giridi ya miri, mibete ya miroho, vhugalelo na fhethu ha maḓi. A hu na vhupo ho avhelwaho u bveledza zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme kha lwendo ulu.

rows.english: Planning considerations: establishment care and long-term responsibility are the main planning questions. A tree drawn on the plan is not evidence that it is planted or bearing fruit.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: ukunakekela ekuqaleni nomthwalo wesikhathi eside kuyimibuzo esemqoka yokuhlela. Isihlahla esidwetshiwe epulanini asibona ubufakazi bokuthi sitshaliwe noma sithela izithelo.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: tlhokomelo ya ho qala le boikarabelo ba nako e telele ke dipotso tse kgolo tsa moralo. Sefate se takilweng moralong ha se bopaki ba hore se lenngwe kapa se beha ditholwana.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: nhlayiso wo simeka ni vutihlamuleri bya nkarhi wo leha i swivutiso swa nkoka swa pulani. Murhi lowu dirowiweke eka pulani a hi vumbhoni bya leswaku wu byariwile kumbe wu tswala mihandzu.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: u ṱhogomela musi hu tshi thomiwa na vhuḓifhinduleli ha tshifhinga tshilapfu ndi mbudziso dza ndeme dza u pulana. Muri wo olwaho kha pulane a si vhuṱanzi ha uri wo ṱavhiwa kana u khou aṋwa mitshelo.

rows.english: Agree a care roster and a planting inventory, then monitor survival by planting cohort. Confirm water arrangements before adding planting commitments.
rows.zu: Vumelanani ngohlelo lokunakekela nohlu lokutshalwa, bese niqapha ukusinda ngokweqoqo elitshalwe ngesikhathi esifanayo. Qinisekisani amalungiselelo amanzi ngaphambi kokwengeza izibopho zokutshala.
rows.st: Dumellanang ka lenane la tlhokomelo le rejisetara ya tse lenngweng, mme le latele ho phela ha difate ka dihlopha tse lenngweng ka nako e le nngwe. Netefatsang ditokisetso tsa metsi pele le eketsa boitlamo ba ho lema.
rows.ts: Pfumelelanani hi nongonoko wa nhlayiso ni rhejisitara ya leswi byariweke, kutani mi landzelela ku hanya hi ntlawa lowu byariweke hi nkarhi wun’we. Tiyisisani malunghiselelo ya mati mi nga si engetela vutiboheleri byo byala.
rows.ve: Tendelani mutevhe wa u ṱhogomela na redzhisiṱara ya zwo ṱavhiwaho, ni tevhelele u tshila nga zwigwada zwo ṱavhiwaho nga tshifhinga tshithihi. Khwaṱhisedzani nzudzanyo dza maḓi phanḓa ha u engedza vhuḓivhofhi ha u ṱavha.

rows.english: Record the condition of planted trees and distinguish existing, new and replacement trees in later reports.
rows.zu: Qophani isimo sezihlahla ezitshaliwe futhi nehlukanise ezikhona, ezintsha nezifakwe esikhundleni kwezinye emibikweni elandelayo.
rows.st: Rekotang boemo ba difate tse lenngweng mme le arole tse seng di le teng, tse ntjha le tse nkang sebaka sa tse ding ditlalehong tse latelang.
rows.ts: Rhekhodani xiyimo xa mirhi leyi byariweke kutani mi hambanisa leyi nga kona, leyintshwa ni leyi siviwaka eka swiviko leswi landzelaka.
rows.ve: Rekhodani nyimele ya miri yo ṱavhiwaho ni fhambanye i re hone, miswa na yo thivhaho miṅwe kha mivhigo i tevhelaho.

rows.english: A shared growing site with communal production and a meeting space.
rows.zu: Indawo yokutshala okwabelwana ngayo enokukhiqiza komphakathi nendawo yokuhlangana.
rows.st: Sebaka sa temo se arolelwanwang, se nang le tlhahiso ya setjhaba le sebaka sa kopano.
rows.ts: Ndhawu yo byala leyi avelaniwaka, yi ri ni vuhumelerisi bya muganga ni ndhawu yo hlangana.
rows.ve: Fhethu ha u ṱavha hu kovhiwaho, hu re na u bveledza ha tshitshavha na fhethu ha muṱangano.

rows.english: The schematic separates the store, meeting area, vegetable blocks, staple area, trees and water point.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kwehlukanisa inqolobane, indawo yokuhlangana, izindawo zemifino, indawo yezitshalo eziyinhloko, izihlahla nephuzu lamanzi.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o arola polokelo, sebaka sa kopano, dikarolo tsa meroho, sebaka sa dijalo tsa motheo, difate le ntlha ya metsi.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi hambanisa vuhlayiselo, ndhawu yo hlangana, swiphemu swa matsavu, ndhawu ya swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka, mirhi ni ndhawu ya mati.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u fhambanya vhugalelo, fhethu ha muṱangano, zwipiḓa zwa miroho, fhethu ha zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme, miri na fhethu ha maḓi.

rows.english: Planning considerations: shared responsibilities, water access and fair record keeping are the main operational issues. Group membership must not be inferred from photographs.
rows.zu: Okucatshangelwayo ekuhleleni: ukwabelana ngemithwalo, ukufinyelela emanzini nokugcina amarekhodi ngobulungisa kuyizindaba ezisemqoka ekusebenzeni. Ubulungu beqembu akufanele bucatshangwe ngezithombe.
rows.st: Dintlha tsa moralo: boikarabelo bo arolelwanwang, phihlello ya metsi le ho boloka direkoto ka toka ke dintlha tse kgolo tsa tshebetso. Botho ba sehlopha ha bo a lokela ho nahanelwa ho tswa ditshwantshong.
rows.ts: Swilo swo anakanyiwa eku pulaneni: vutihlamuleri byo avelana, mfikelelo wa mati ni ku hlayisa tirhekhodo hi vululami i timhaka ta nkoka ta matirhelo. Vuxirho bya ntlawa a byi fanelanga ku mbambeleriwa hi swifaniso.
rows.ve: Zwi sedzwaho kha u pulana: vhuḓifhinduleli ho kovhiwaho, u swikelela maḓi na u vhulunga rekhodo nga nḓila yo linganaho ndi mafhungo a ndeme a mushumo. U vha muraḓo wa tshigwada a zwi tei u humbulelwa nga zwifanyiso.

rows.english: Agree the work roster, access arrangements and produce distribution records. Assign an owner to each follow-up action.
rows.zu: Vumelanani ngohlelo lomsebenzi, amalungiselelo okufinyelela namarekhodi okwabiwa komkhiqizo. Bekani umuntu ophethe isinyathelo ngasinye sokulandelela.
rows.st: Dumellanang ka lenane la mosebetsi, ditokisetso tsa phihlello le direkoto tsa kabo ya dihlahiswa. Abelang motho boikarabelo ba mohato ka mong wa ho latela.
rows.ts: Pfumelelanani hi nongonoko wa mintirho, malunghiselelo ya mfikelelo ni tirhekhodo ta ku avela ntshovelo. Nyikani munhu un’wana ni un’wana vutihlamuleri eka goza rin’wana ni rin’wana ro landzelela.
rows.ve: Tendelani mutevhe wa mushumo, nzudzanyo dza u swikelela na rekhodo dza u kovha zwibveledzwa. Vheani muthu a re na vhuḓifhinduleli kha ḽiga ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa u tevhelela.

rows.english: Review the roster and support needs with the group; compare dated records before reporting changes in results.
rows.zu: Buyekezani uhlelo nezidingo zosizo neqembu; qhathanisani amarekhodi anezinsuku ngaphambi kokubika izinguquko emiphumeleni.
rows.st: Hlahlobang lenane le ditlhoko tsa tshehetso le sehlopha; bapisang direkoto tse nang le matsatsi pele le tlaleha diphetoho diphethong.
rows.ts: Kambelani nongonoko ni swilaveko swa nseketelo ni ntlawa; pimanisani tirhekhodo leti nga ni masiku mi nga si vika ku cinca ka mimbuyelo.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani mutevhe na ṱhoḓea dza thikhedzo na tshigwada; vhambedzani rekhodo dzi re na maḓuvha phanḓa ha u vhiga tshanduko kha mvelelo.

rows.st: Sebaka se setseng se kenyelletsa meaho ya mohlala, ditsela tsa phihlello, dibaka tsa difate le sebaka se seng. Ha se fumanehe bakeng sa ho lema ka bo sona. Dibaka di tswa rejisetareng ya leeto, eseng ditekanyong tse nahanelwang ho tswa setshwantshong.
rows.ts: Ndhawu leyi saleke yi katsa miako ya nhlamuselo, mfikelelo, tindhawu ta mirhi ni tindhawu tin’wana. A yi kumeki ku byala hi yoxe. Vukulu byi huma eka rhejisitara ya rendzo, ku nga ri eka mipimo leyi mbambeleriwaka eka xifaniso.
rows.ve: Vhupo ho salaho vhu katela zwifhaṱo zwa tsumbo, u swikelela, fhethu ha miri na huṅwe fhethu. A zwi ambi uri hu wanala u ṱavha nga hoṱhe. Vhupo vhu bva kha redzhisiṱara ya lwendo, a si kha zwikalo zwi humbulelwaho nga tshifanyiso.

rows.english: Soil planning: bed condition and soil management should be considered with water and access. No measured laboratory result is supplied for this example, so no pH, nutrient concentration or amendment rate is asserted.
rows.zu: Ukuhlela umhlabathi: isimo semibhede nokuphathwa komhlabathi kufanele kucatshangelwe kanye namanzi nokufinyelela. Akukho mphumela olinganisiwe waselabhorethri onikeziwe kulesi sibonelo, ngakho akuqinisekiswa i-pH, ukugxila kwezakhamzimba noma izinga lokufaka okulungisa umhlabathi.
rows.st: Moralo wa mobu: boemo ba dibethe le taolo ya mobu di lokela ho nahanelwa hammoho le metsi le phihlello. Ha ho sephetho sa laboratori se lekantsweng se fanweng mohlaleng ona, kahoo ha ho pH, bongata ba dimatlafatsi kapa tekanyo ya dintho tse lokisang mobu e tiiswang.
rows.ts: Ku pulana misava: xiyimo xa mibedo ni vulawuri bya misava swi fanele ku anakanyiwa swin’we ni mati ni mfikelelo. A ku nyikiwanga mbuyelo lowu pimiweke wa laboratori eka xikombiso lexi, kutani a ku tiyisisiwi pH, ku tala ka swakudya swa misava kumbe mpimo wa leswi lunghisaka misava.
rows.ve: U pulana mavu: nyimele ya mibete na ndangulo ya mavu zwi tea u sedzwa na maḓi na u swikelela. A hu na mvelelo yo kaliwaho ya laboratori yo ṋetshedzwaho kha tsumbo iyi, ngauralo a hu khwaṱhisedzwi pH, khwaṱhiso ya pfushi kana tshikalo tsha u shuma zwithu zwa u khwinisa mavu.

rows.english: The reference photograph illustrates this garden type. Its visible details are not a verified inventory and cannot establish dimensions, ownership, water availability or soil properties.
rows.zu: Isithombe esiyinkomba sibonisa lolu hlobo lwengadi. Imininingwane ebonakalayo ayilona uhlu oluqinisekisiwe futhi ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa ubukhulu, ubunikazi, ukutholakala kwamanzi noma izakhiwo zomhlabathi.
rows.st: Setshwantsho sa mohlala se bontsha mofuta ona wa tshimo. Dintlha tse bonahalang ha se rejisetara e netefaditsweng mme ha di kgone ho netefatsa boholo, beng, boteng ba metsi kapa dimelo tsa mobu.
rows.ts: Xifaniso xo komba xi komba muxaka lowu wa ntanga. Vuxokoxoko bya xona lexi vonakaka a hi rhejisitara leyi tiyisisiweke naswona a byi tiyisisi mipimo, vun’winyi, ku kumeka ka mati kumbe swihlawulekisi swa misava.
rows.ve: Tshifanyiso tsha tsumbo tshi sumbedza lushaka ulu lwa ngade. Zwine zwa vhonala a si mutevhe wo khwaṱhisedzwaho nahone a zwi koni u khwaṱhisedza vhuhulwane, vhuṋe, u wanala ha maḓi kana zwivhumbeo zwa mavu.

rows.english: Water, infrastructure and planting needs
rows.zu: Izidingo zamanzi, ingqalasizinda nokutshala
rows.st: Ditlhoko tsa metsi, meaho ya motheo le ho lema
rows.ts: Swilaveko swa mati, switirhisiwa swa masungulo ni ku byala
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓea dza maḓi, themamveledziso na u ṱavha

rows.english: The schematic marks a water point. Its source, storage capacity, reliability and installation status have not been measured in this tour.
rows.zu: Ukuhleleka okuyisibonelo kuphawula iphuzu lamanzi. Umthombo walo, umthamo wokugcina, ukuthembeka nesimo sokufakwa akukalinganiswa kulolu hambo.
rows.st: Moralo wa mohlala o tshwaya ntlha ya metsi. Mohlodi, bokgoni ba polokelo, botshepehi le boemo ba ho kenngwa ha yona ha di a lekanngwa leetong lena.
rows.ts: Pulani ya nhlamuselo yi fungha ndhawu ya mati. Xihlovo xa yona, vukulu byo hlayisa, ku tshembeka ni xiyimo xo nghenisiwa a swi pimiwanga eka rendzo leri.
rows.ve: Mveledziso wa tsumbo u swaya fhethu ha maḓi. Tshiko tshaho, vhuhulwane ha u vhulunga, u fulufhedzea na nyimele ya u dzheniswa a zwo ngo kaliwa kha lwendo ulu.

rows.english: Vegetable and staple allocations are recorded separately. Tree symbols indicate planning context; species, number planted, survival and maturity need their own evidence.
rows.zu: Izindawo ezabelwe imifino nezitshalo eziyinhloko ziqoshwa ngokwehlukana. Izimpawu zezihlahla zibonisa isimo sokuhlela; izinhlobo, inani elitshaliwe, ukusinda nokuvuthwa kudinga ubufakazi bakho.
rows.st: Dibaka tse abetsweng meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di rekotwa ka thoko. Matshwao a difate a bontsha moelelo wa moralo; mefuta, palo e lenngweng, ho phela le kgolo di hloka bopaki ba tsona.
rows.ts: Swiphemu leswi averiweke matsavu ni swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka swi rhekhodiwa hi ku hambana. Swikombiso swa mirhi swi komba mongo wa pulani; tinxaka, nhlayo leyi byariweke, ku hanya ni ku kula swi lava vumbhoni bya swona.
rows.ve: Vhupo ho avhelwaho miroho na zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme vhu rekhodwa ho fhambanywa. Zwiga zwa miri zwi sumbedza nyimele ya u pulana; tshaka, mbalo yo ṱavhiwaho, u tshila na u vhibva zwi ṱoḓa vhuṱanzi hazwo.

rows.english: Any water storage or solar proposal needs an appropriate specification, installation plan, costs and maintenance responsibility before it becomes a funded deliverable.
rows.zu: Noma yisiphi isiphakamiso sokugcina amanzi noma samandla elanga sidinga imininingwane efanele, ipulani lokufaka, izindleko nomuntu ophethe ukunakekela ngaphambi kokuba sibe umsebenzi oxhaswe ngemali okufanele ulethwe.
rows.st: Tshisinyo efe kapa efe ya polokelo ya metsi kapa ya matla a letsatsi e hloka ditlhaloso tse loketseng, moralo wa ho kenya, ditjeho le boikarabelo ba tlhokomelo pele e eba mosebetsi o tsheheditsweng ka ditjhelete o lokelang ho phethwa.
rows.ts: Xiringanyeto xin’wana ni xin’wana xo hlayisa mati kumbe xa eneji ya dyambu xi lava nhlamuselo leyi faneleke, pulani yo nghenisa, tihakelo ni vutihlamuleri bya nhlayiso xi nga si va ntiro lowu faneleke ku nyiketiwa lowu seketeriwaka hi mali.
rows.ve: Khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u vhulunga maḓi kana ya maanḓa a ḓuvha i ṱoḓa ṱhaluso yo teaho, pulane ya u dzhenisa, mbadelo na vhuḓifhinduleli ha u ṱhogomela phanḓa ha u vha mushumo wo lambedzwaho une wa tea u ṋetshedzwa.

rows.english: Production, participation and learning
rows.zu: Ukukhiqiza, ukubamba iqhaza nokufunda
rows.st: Tlhahiso, ho nka karolo le ho ithuta
rows.ts: Vuhumelerisi, ku teka xiave ni ku dyondza
rows.ve: U bveledza, u shela mulenzhe na u guda

rows.english: Harvest logged: {produce} kg. This is the same total shown in this garden profile. It is not a yield forecast or independently verified result.
rows.zu: Isivuno esiqoshiwe: {produce} kg. Lena yingqikithi efanayo naleyo eboniswa kuphrofayela yale ngadi. Akusona isibikezelo sesivuno noma umphumela oqinisekiswe ngokuzimela.
rows.st: Kotulo e rekotilweng: {produce} kg. Ena ke kakaretso e tshwanang le e bontshitsweng boitsebisong ba tshimo ena. Ha se ponelopele ya kotulo kapa sephetho se netefaditsweng ka boikemelo.
rows.ts: Ntshovelo lowu rhekhodiweke: {produce} kg. Leyi i ntsengo lowu fanaka ni lowu kombiweke eka vuxokoxoko bya ntanga lowu. A hi ku vhumbha ntshovelo kumbe mbuyelo lowu tiyisisiweke hi ndlela leyi tiyimeleke.
rows.ve: Khaṋo yo rekhodiwaho: {produce} kg. Ndi mbalo yoṱhe i fanaho na yo sumbedzwaho kha phurofaiḽi ya ngade iyi. A si nyelelo ya khaṋo kana mvelelo yo khwaṱhisedzwaho nga vha ḓiimisaho.

rows.english: {farmers} adult participants are in this example register. The displayed {training}% training figure is progress, not proof of improved livelihoods.
rows.zu: Abantu abadala abangu-{farmers} ababambe iqhaza bakule rejista eyisibonelo. Isibalo sokuqeqeshwa esingu-{training}% esiboniswayo siyinqubekela phambili, akubona ubufakazi bokuthuthuka kwezindlela zokuziphilisa.
rows.st: Bankakarolo ba baholo ba {farmers} ba rejisetareng ena ya mohlala. Palo ya thupelo ya {training}% e bontshitsweng ke kgatelopele, ha se bopaki ba ho ntlafala ha mekgwa ya boiphediso.
rows.ts: Vatekaxiave lavakulu va {farmers} va le ka rhejisitara leyi ya xikombiso. Nhlayo ya ndzetelo ya {training}% leyi kombiweke i nhluvuko, a hi vumbhoni bya ku antswisiwa ka tindlela to tihanyisa.
rows.ve: Vhashelamulenzhe vhahulwane vha {farmers} vha kha redzhisiṱara iyi ya tsumbo. Mbalo ya vhugudisi yo sumbedzwaho ya {training}% ndi mvelaphanḓa, a si vhuṱanzi ha u khwiniswa ha maitele a u ḓitshidza.

rows.english: The catalogue does not provide a common crop-by-crop reporting period for every garden. Do not calculate annual yield, profitability or household savings from these totals.
rows.zu: Ikhathalogi ayinikezi isikhathi esifanayo sokubika ngesitshalo ngasinye kuyo yonke ingadi. Ningabali isivuno sonyaka, inzuzo noma ukonga kwasekhaya ngalezi ngqikithi.
rows.st: Lenane ha le fane ka nako e tshwanang ya ho tlaleha sejalo ka seng bakeng sa tshimo ka nngwe. Le se ke la bala kotulo ya selemo, phaello kapa dipolokelo tsa lelapa ho tswa dikakaretsong tsena.
rows.ts: Khathalogu a yi nyiki nkarhi lowu fanaka wo vika hi xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana eka ntanga wun’wana ni wun’wana. Mi nga hlayeli ntshovelo wa lembe, ku vuyela ka bindzu kumbe ku hlayisa mali ka muti hi mintsengo leyi.
rows.ve: Khathaḽogo a i ṋetshedzi tshifhinga tshi fanaho tsha u vhiga tshimela nga tshimela kha ngade iṅwe na iṅwe. Ni songo vhalela khaṋo ya ṅwaha, u vhuelwa kana tshelede yo vhulungwaho ya muḓi nga mbalo idzi dzoṱhe.

rows.english: A live report should distinguish produce kept, donated, sold and lost, and use dated attendance and assessments for learning outcomes.
rows.zu: Umbiko obukhoma kufanele wehlukanise umkhiqizo ogciniwe, onikelwe, othengisiwe nolahlekile, futhi usebenzise ukuba khona nokuhlola okunezinsuku ngemiphumela yokufunda.
rows.st: Tlaleho ya nnete e lokela ho arola dihlahiswa tse bolokilweng, tse fanweng, tse rekisitsweng le tse lahlehileng, mme e sebedise ho ba teng le ditekolo tse nang le matsatsi bakeng sa diphetho tsa thuto.
rows.ts: Xiviko xa xiviri xi fanele ku hambanisa ntshovelo lowu hlayisiweke, lowu nyikeriweke, lowu xavisiweke ni lowu lahlekeke, xi tlhela xi tirhisa vukona ni mikambelo leyi nga ni masiku eka mimbuyelo ya dyondzo.
rows.ve: Muvhigo wa vhukuma u tea u fhambanya zwibveledzwa zwo vhulungwaho, zwo ṋetshedzwaho, zwo rengiswaho na zwo xelelaho, wa shumisa u vha hone na tsenguluso zwi re na maḓuvha kha mvelelo dza u guda.

rows.english: Orchard bookkeeping example
rows.zu: Isibonelo sokugcina amabhuku engadi yezithelo
rows.st: Mohlala wa ho boloka dibuka tsa tshimo ya ditholwana
rows.ts: Xikombiso xa vuhlayisi bya tibuku ta ntanga wa mihandzu
rows.ve: Tsumbo ya u vhulunga bugu dza ngade ya mitshelo

rows.english: Worked records for exploring fruit and nut capture; these are separate from the garden profile total above and do not establish planted species or seasonal yields.
rows.zu: Amarekhodi asebenziwe okuhlola ukuqoshwa kwezithelo nezinhlobo ezibizwa ngokuthi “nuts”; ahlukile engqikithini yephrofayela yengadi engenhla futhi awaqinisekisi izinhlobo ezitshaliwe noma isivuno sesizini.
rows.st: Direkoto tsa mohlala tsa ho hlahloba ho rekota ditholwana le tse bitswang “nuts”; di arohane le kakaretso ya boitsebiso ba tshimo e ka hodimo mme ha di netefatse mefuta e lenngweng kapa dikotulo tsa sehla.
rows.ts: Tirhekhodo leti tirhiweke ku kambela ku rhekhoda mihandzu ni leswi vuriwaka “nuts”; ti hambanile ni ntsengo wa vuxokoxoko bya ntanga laha henhla naswona a ti tiyisisi tinxaka leti byariweke kumbe ntshovelo wa nguva.
rows.ve: Rekhodo dza tsumbo dza u sedzulusa u rekhoda mitshelo na zwine zwa vhidzwa “nuts”; dzo fhambana na mbalo yoṱhe ya phurofaiḽi ya ngade i re afho nṱha nahone a dzi khwaṱhisedzi tshaka dzo ṱavhiwaho kana khaṋo dza khalaṅwaha.

rows.english: {crop}: {picked} kg picked; {sold} kg sold; {retained} kg retained; R{received} received.
rows.zu: {crop}: {picked} kg kuvuniwe; {sold} kg kuthengisiwe; {retained} kg kugciniwe; R{received} kwamukelwe.
rows.st: {crop}: {picked} kg e kotutsweng; {sold} kg e rekisitsweng; {retained} kg e bolokilweng; R{received} e amohetsweng.
rows.ts: {crop}: {picked} kg leyi khiweke; {sold} kg leyi xavisiweke; {retained} kg leyi hlayisiweke; R{received} leyi amukeriweke.
rows.ve: {crop}: {picked} kg yo kaṋwaho; {sold} kg yo rengiswaho; {retained} kg yo vhulungwaho; R{received} yo ṱanganedzwaho.

rows.english: Open Records to view the connected harvests, sales and invoices. Orchard quantities can be included or excluded from harvest graphs; orchard income is not divided by vegetable-bed area.
rows.zu: Vulani Amarekhodi ukuze nibone isivuno, ukuthengisiwe nama-invoyisi axhunyiwe. Amanani engadi yezithelo angafakwa noma akhishwe emagrafini esivuno; imali engenayo engadini yezithelo ayihlukaniswa ngendawo yemibhede yemifino.
rows.st: Bulang Direkoto ho bona dikotulo, thekiso le di-invoice tse hokahaneng. Bongata ba tshimo ya ditholwana bo ka kenyeletswa kapa ba tloswa dikerafo tsa kotulo; lekeno la tshimo ya ditholwana ha le arolwe ka sebaka sa dibethe tsa meroho.
rows.ts: Pfulani Tirhekhodo ku vona ntshovelo, ku xavisa ni ti-invoice leti hlanganisiweke. Tinhlayo ta ntanga wa mihandzu ti nga katsiwa kumbe ti susiwa eka tigirafu ta ntshovelo; mali ya ntanga wa mihandzu a yi avanyisiwi hi vukulu bya mibedo ya matsavu.
rows.ve: Vhulani Rekhodo u vhona khaṋo, u rengisa na invoyisi zwo ṱumanywaho. Mbalo dza ngade ya mitshelo dzi nga katelwa kana dza bviswa kha girafu dza khaṋo; tshelede ya ngade ya mitshelo a i kovhekanywi nga vhuhulwane ha mibete ya miroho.

rows.english: BOQ and funding readiness
rows.zu: I-BOQ nokulungela uxhaso lwezimali
rows.st: BOQ le boitokisetso ba tshehetso ya ditjhelete
rows.ts: BOQ ni ku lunghekela nseketelo wa mali
rows.ve: BOQ na u lugela ndambedzo

rows.english: Known quantity basis: {vegetableArea} m² of vegetable area and {stapleArea} m² of staple area. These allocations are not construction specifications.
rows.zu: Isisekelo samanani aziwayo: {vegetableArea} m² wendawo yemifino no-{stapleArea} m² wendawo yezitshalo eziyinhloko. Lokhu kwabiwa akuyona imininingwane yokwakha.
rows.st: Motheo wa bongata bo tsejwang: {vegetableArea} m² ya sebaka sa meroho le {stapleArea} m² ya sebaka sa dijalo tsa motheo. Dikabo tsena ha se ditlhaloso tsa kaho.
rows.ts: Masungulo ya tinhlayo leti tivekaka: {vegetableArea} m² ya ndhawu ya matsavu ni {stapleArea} m² ya ndhawu ya swibyariwa swa swakudya swa nkoka. Swiphemu leswi a hi swilaveko swa vuaki.
rows.ve: Mutheo wa mbalo dzi ḓivheaho: {vegetableArea} m² ya vhupo ha miroho na {stapleArea} m² ya vhupo ha zwimela zwa zwiḽiwa zwa ndeme. Zwavhelo izwi a si ṱhaluso dza u fhaṱa.

rows.english: This overview has no measured construction quantities or supplier quotations. Unpriced needs are not zero-cost needs; funding commitments require confirmation.
rows.zu: Lokhu kubuka konke akunamanani okwakha alinganisiwe noma izingcaphuno zamanani zabahlinzeki. Izidingo ezingenamanani azizona izidingo ezingenazindleko; izibopho zoxhaso zidinga ukuqinisekiswa.
rows.st: Kakaretso ena ha e na bongata ba kaho bo lekantsweng kapa ditheko tse qotsitsweng ke bafepedi. Ditlhoko tse sa rekwang ha se ditlhoko tse se nang ditjeho; boitlamo ba tshehetso ya ditjhelete bo hloka netefatso.
rows.ts: Nkatsakanyo lowu a wu na tinhlayo ta vuaki leti pimiweke kumbe minxavo leyi nyikeriweke hi vaphakeri. Swilaveko leswi nga riki na nxavo a swi vuli leswaku a swi na tihakelo; vutiboheleri bya nseketelo wa mali byi lava ku tiyisisiwa.
rows.ve: Manweledzo aya a a na mbalo dza u fhaṱa dzo kaliwaho kana khotheisheni dza vhaṋetshedzi. Ṱhoḓea dzi si na mitengo a si ṱhoḓea dzi si na mbadelo; vhuḓivhofhi ha ndambedzo vhu ṱoḓa u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Assess complete packages where needed: water storage with its base and connections; planting with establishment care; solar equipment with commissioning. Verify quantities and dependencies before pricing.
rows.zu: Hlolani amaphakheji aphelele lapho kudingeka: ukugcina amanzi kanye nesisekelo nokuxhumana kwawo; ukutshala nokunakekela ekuqaleni; izinto zamandla elanga nokuqaliswa kwazo. Qinisekisani amanani nokuncikana ngaphambi kokubeka amanani entengo.
rows.st: Lekolang diphutheloana tse felletseng moo ho hlokahalang: polokelo ya metsi le motheo le dikgokelo tsa yona; ho lema le tlhokomelo ya ho qala; thepa ya matla a letsatsi le ho e qala ho sebetsa. Netefatsang bongata le tse itshetlehileng ka tse ding pele le beha ditheko.
rows.ts: Kambelani maphakheji lama heleleke laha swi lavekaka: ku hlayisa mati ni masungulo ni vuhlanganisi bya kona; ku byala ni nhlayiso wo simeka; switirhisiwa swa eneji ya dyambu ni ku swi sungula ku tirha. Tiyisisani tinhlayo ni leswi titshegeke hi swin’wana mi nga si veka minxavo.
rows.ve: Sengulusani phakheji dzo fhelelaho hune zwa ṱoḓea: u vhulunga maḓi na mutheo na ṱhumanyo dzaho; u ṱavha na u ṱhogomela musi hu tshi thomiwa; zwishumiswa zwa maanḓa a ḓuvha na u zwi thoma u shuma. Khwaṱhisedzani mbalo na zwi ḓisendekaho nga zwiṅwe phanḓa ha u vhea mitengo.

rows.english: Keep approved current-project work separate from additional needs outside the budget. The proposed Funding & delivery workflow will connect those needs to costed BOQs and funder allocations; that full workflow is not yet available.
rows.zu: Gcinani umsebenzi ovunyelwe wephrojekthi yamanje wehlukile ezidingweni ezengeziwe ezingaphandle kwesabelomali. Indlela ehlongozwayo yoXhaso nokulethwa izoxhumanisa lezo zidingo nama-BOQ anezindleko nokwabiwa ngabaxhasi; leyo ndlela ephelele ayikatholakali.
rows.st: Bolokang mosebetsi o dumelletsweng wa projeke ya hona jwale o arohane le ditlhoko tse eketsehileng tse kantle ho tekanyetso. Tshebetso e sisintsweng ya Tshehetso ya ditjhelete le phano e tla hokahanya ditlhoko tseo le di-BOQ tse nang le ditjeho le dikabo tsa bafani; tshebetso eo e felletseng ha e so fumanehe.
rows.ts: Hlayisani ntiro lowu pfumeleriweke wa phurojeke ya sweswi wu hambanile ni swilaveko swo engetela leswi nga ehandle ka mpimanyeto. Ndlela leyi ringanyetiweke ya Nseketelo wa mali ni ku nyiketa yi ta hlanganisa swilaveko leswi ni ti-BOQ leti nga ni tihakelo ni swiphemu swa vaseketeri; ndlela leyi heleleke a yi si kumeka.
rows.ve: Vhulungani mushumo wo tendelwaho wa thandela ya zwino wo fhambana na ṱhoḓea dzo engedzeaho dzi re nnḓa ha mugaganyagwama. Maitele o dzinginywaho a Ndambedzo na u ṋetshedza a ḓo ṱumanya ṱhoḓea idzo na BOQ dzi re na mbadelo na zwavhelo zwa vhalambedzi; maitele eneo o fhelelaho ha athu wanala.

rows.english: Delivery evidence and next actions
rows.zu: Ubufakazi bokulethwa nezinyathelo ezilandelayo
rows.st: Bopaki ba phano le mehato e latelang
rows.ts: Vumbhoni bya ku nyiketa ni magoza lama landzelaka
rows.ve: Vhuṱanzi ha u ṋetshedza na maga a tevhelaho

rows.english: Priority follow-up: arrange a support visit and agree the main constraint with the group before expanding the plan.
rows.zu: Okulandelelwayo okusemqoka: hlelani ukuvakasha kosizo futhi nivumelane neqembu ngesithiyo esikhulu ngaphambi kokwandisa ipulani.
rows.st: Tse tlang pele tsa ho latela: hlophisang ketelo ya tshehetso mme le dumellane le sehlopha ka tshitiso e kgolo pele le atolosa moralo.
rows.ts: Ku landzelela loku rhangisiwaka: hlelani riendzo ra nseketelo kutani mi pfumelelana ni ntlawa hi xihinga lexikulu mi nga si ndlandlamuxa pulani.
rows.ve: U tevhelela hu rangiswaho: dzudzanyani lwendo lwa thikhedzo ni tendele na tshigwada nga ha tshikhukhulisi tshihulwane phanḓa ha u ṱanḓavhudza pulane.

rows.english: Priority follow-up: confirm establishment tasks, responsible people and the first dated progress check.
rows.zu: Okulandelelwayo okusemqoka: qinisekisani imisebenzi yokuqala, abantu abaphethe nokuhlola kokuqala kwenqubekela phambili okunosuku.
rows.st: Tse tlang pele tsa ho latela: netefatsang mesebetsi ya ho qala, batho ba ikarabellang le tekolo ya pele ya kgatelopele e nang le letsatsi.
rows.ts: Ku landzelela loku rhangisiwaka: tiyisisani mintirho yo simeka, vanhu lava nga ni vutihlamuleri ni nkambelo wo sungula wa nhluvuko lowu nga ni siku.
rows.ve: U tevhelela hu rangiswaho: khwaṱhisedzani mishumo ya u thoma, vhathu vha re na vhuḓifhinduleli na tsenguluso ya u thoma ya mvelaphanḓa i re na ḓuvha.

rows.english: Priority follow-up: maintain the work roster and review evidence before sharing the next programme update.
rows.zu: Okulandelelwayo okusemqoka: gcinani uhlelo lomsebenzi futhi nibuyekeze ubufakazi ngaphambi kokwabelana ngezindaba zohlelo ezilandelayo.
rows.st: Tse tlang pele tsa ho latela: bolokang lenane la mosebetsi mme le hlahlobe bopaki pele le arolelana ditaba tse latelang tsa lenaneo.
rows.ts: Ku landzelela loku rhangisiwaka: hlayisani nongonoko wa mintirho kutani mi kambela vumbhoni mi nga si avelana mahungu lama landzelaka ya nongonoko.
rows.ve: U tevhelela hu rangiswaho: vhulungani mutevhe wa mushumo ni sedzuluse vhuṱanzi phanḓa ha u kovha mveledziso i tevhelaho ya mbekanyamushumo.

rows.english: Record installed tanks and storage capacity separately from measured water collected. Record commissioned solar capacity separately from energy produced. Record planted trees separately from survival and fruit harvest.
rows.zu: Qophani amathangi afakiwe nomthamo wokugcina ngokwehlukana namanzi aqoqiwe alinganisiwe. Qophani amandla elanga aqalisiwe ngokwehlukana namandla akhiqiziwe. Qophani izihlahla ezitshaliwe ngokwehlukana nokusinda nesivuno sezithelo.
rows.st: Rekotang ditanka tse kentsweng le bokgoni ba polokelo ka thoko ho metsi a bokelletsweng a lekantsweng. Rekotang bokgoni ba matla a letsatsi bo qadileng ho sebetsa ka thoko ho eneji e hlahisitsweng. Rekotang difate tse lenngweng ka thoko ho ho phela ha tsona le kotulo ya ditholwana.
rows.ts: Rhekhodani mathangi lama nghenisiweke ni vukulu byo hlayisa swi hambanile ni mati lama hlengeletiweke lama pimiweke. Rhekhodani vukulu bya eneji ya dyambu leyi sunguleke ku tirha byi hambanile ni eneji leyi humesiweke. Rhekhodani mirhi leyi byariweke yi hambanile ni ku hanya ni ntshovelo wa mihandzu.
rows.ve: Rekhodani mathannga o dzheniswaho na vhuhulwane ha u vhulunga zwo fhambanywa na maḓi o kuvhanganywaho o kaliwaho. Rekhodani vhuhulwane ha maanḓa a ḓuvha o thomaho u shuma ho fhambanywa na maanḓa o bveledzwaho. Rekhodani miri yo ṱavhiwaho yo fhambanywa na u tshila na khaṋo ya mitshelo.

rows.english: Use dated photos, receipts, visit records and appropriate operational checks. A paid invoice or an AI-generated image does not verify a completed installation.
rows.zu: Sebenzisani izithombe ezinezinsuku, amarisidi, amarekhodi okuvakasha nokuhlola kokusebenza okufanele. I-invoyisi ekhokhiwe noma isithombe esenziwe nge-AI akuqinisekisi ukufakwa okuqediwe.
rows.st: Sebedisang ditshwantsho tse nang le matsatsi, dirasiti, direkoto tsa ketelo le ditekolo tse loketseng tsa tshebetso. Invoice e lefilweng kapa setshwantsho se entsweng ka AI ha se netefatse hore ho kenya ho phethilwe.
rows.ts: Tirhisani swifaniso leswi nga ni masiku, tirhisiti, tirhekhodo ta maendzo ni mikambelo leyi faneleke ya matirhelo. Invoice leyi hakeriweke kumbe xifaniso lexi endliweke hi AI a swi tiyisisi ku nghenisiwa loku hetisiweke.
rows.ve: Shumisani zwifanyiso zwi re na maḓuvha, rasithi, rekhodo dza nyendo na tsenguluso dzo teaho dza u shuma. Invoyisi yo badelwaho kana tshifanyiso tsho itwaho nga AI a zwi khwaṱhisedzi uri u dzhenisa ho fhela.

rows.zu: Kulungiswe ngamarekhodi ohambo; akukho kuhlola indawo kobuchwepheshe noma ukuhlaziya okubukhoma okwenziwe.
rows.st: E lokisitswe ho tswa direkotong tsa leeto; ha ho phuputso ya sebaka ya setsebi kapa tshekatsheko ya nnete e entsweng.
rows.ts: Xi lunghiseleriwe hi tirhekhodo ta rendzo; a ku endliwanga vukambisisi bya ndhawu bya xiphurofexinali kumbe nxopaxopo wa xiviri.
rows.ve: Zwo lugiswa nga rekhodo dza lwendo; a hu na ṱhoḓisiso ya fhethu ya phurofeshinala kana tsenguluso ya zwino yo itwaho.

rows.english: The photograph is AI-generated and the layout is schematic, not to scale. Adult portraits elsewhere in the tour may repeat.
rows.zu: Isithombe senziwe nge-AI kanti ukuhleleka kuyisibonelo, akusikho ngokwesilinganiso. Imifanekiso yabantu abadala kwezinye izindawo zohambo ingaphindeka.
rows.st: Setshwantsho se entswe ka AI mme moralo ke wa mohlala, ha o ya ka sekala. Ditshwantsho tsa batho ba baholo dibakeng tse ding tsa leeto di ka ipheta.
rows.ts: Xifaniso xi endliwe hi AI naswona pulani i ya nhlamuselo, a yi endliwanga hi xikalo. Swifaniso swa swikandza swa lavakulu etindhawini tin’wana ta rendzo swi nga ha phindhiwa.
rows.ve: Tshifanyiso tsho itwa nga AI nahone mveledziso ndi wa tsumbo, a u tevhedzi tshikalo. Zwifanyiso zwa zwifhaṱuwo zwa vhahulwane kha zwiṅwe zwipiḓa zwa lwendo zwi nga dovhololwa.

rows.english: Use the separate Ubhejane workspace for the connected editable farm design. Opening this garden report does not overwrite any real map or report.
rows.zu: Sebenzisani indawo ehlukile yase-Ubhejane ngomklamo wepulazi oxhunyiwe ongahlelwa. Ukuvula lo mbiko wengadi akubhali phezu kwanoma iyiphi imephu noma umbiko wangempela.
rows.st: Sebedisang sebaka se arohaneng sa mosebetsi sa Ubhejane bakeng sa moralo o hokahaneng wa polasi o ka hlophiswang. Ho bula tlaleho ena ya tshimo ha ho ngole hodima mmapa kapa tlaleho ya nnete.
rows.ts: Tirhisani ndhawu ya ntiro ya Ubhejane leyi hambaneke eka pulani ya purasi leyi hlanganisiweke leyi nga hleriwaka. Ku pfula xiviko lexi xa ntanga a swi tsali ehenhla ka mepe kumbe xiviko xa xiviri.
rows.ve: Shumisani fhethu ha mushumo ha Ubhejane ho fhambanaho kha pulane ya bulasi yo ṱumanywaho i koneaho u lugiswa. U vula muvhigo uyu wa ngade a zwi ṅwali nṱha ha mapa kana muvhigo wa vhukuma.
